# Media.io

> > Media.io is a free online media conversion and editing platform offering video conversion, audio extraction, watermark removal, and AI-powered editing tools.

Media.io provides browser-based tools for converting between formats like MP4, MP3, AVI, and MKV, alongside video editing features for YouTube and social media. The platform supports multiple devices including Mac, iPhone, and Android with integration to services like Dropbox.

## Key Topics

- Online video converter
- MP4 and MP3 conversion
- AVI to MP4 conversion
- Vocal remover and audio extraction
- YouTube video editor
- Watermark removal
- File format conversion (MKV, AAC, M4B)
- Free video editing tools
- Audio mixing and mastering
- SVG to BMP image conversion
- Mac and iPhone compatibility
- Wondershare UniConverter
- DVD burning
- Slideshow creation
- Browser-based media tools
